svg.title: Stage 07 Culminating Assembly: Taylor–Wiles Prime Triangle, Ribet Clearing Operator, Budget Ledger, and Regular Twist Families
svg.desc: Editorial mathematical diagram tracing the culminating assembly of Stage 07 across DenominatorBound.lean and FitTwistsExist.lean into New.exists_isRegularFamily and full 8-pillar closure. Band 1 (Cobalt and Rust callout) pairs two inputs: on the left, an upper-triangular matrix graphic depicting IsPrimeTriangle (exists_taylorWilesPlaces_hasRootChain) over auxiliary places Q_j with q_j congruent to 1 mod ell^nu ordered by 0 < e(j) < t'; Kummer reciprocity over E+ eliminates all even Tate-twist classes (evenClasses) algebraically—a Vandiver bypass that never bounds |evenClasses|—with cyclotomic separation loss h_2^22 * h (h = 0 for ell > h_2^2), while Chebotarev density preserves weak-lift root chains prod_{i < t'} (X - q_j^i) * e_j(X) with e_j(1) = 1. On the right, three paired bounds enter exists_isCommonRibetElement_ellVal_le: odd classes shaOdd bounded unconditionally via Mazur-Wiles (oddClassBound D <= 2^(4(N_cyc+t+3)^27) * h_E), local crystalline dual defect localDefectBound D ell = 4f * defectBound D ell (CrystallineDefect.lean), and short twisted Selmer length and ramified partial Hecke L-value ratios <= e'_ell = twistError ell D (TwistingTheorem.lean). Band 2 (Emerald, DenominatorBound.lean) flows from exists_isCommonRibetElement_ellVal_le (v_ell(N^2 d) <= liftValuationBound) plus false-lift orthogonality (typeProjection_sub_starProjection_mem_of_isOrthogonalToFalseLifts) into the diagonal Ribet clearing operator Lambda_0 on Z (exists_operator_ellVal_le_liftValuationBound), rescales Lambda = N * Lambda_0 by N = D.chosenGroupOrder (exists_operator_det_clearingBound), and proves denominatorLe_clearingBound with clearingBound D ell = localDefectBound + (1 + 2t) e'_ell + denominatorError + v_ell(N), clearing both range (D.goodLift theta j) (denominatorLe_range_goodLift) and rank-1 main-pair lines (denominatorLe_span_trivialLift). Band 3 (Amber, FitTwistsExist.lean::sum_clearingBound_add_padicValNat_le) displays the five-term prime-weighted budget ledger weighted by log ell: localDefectBound <= 4*10^6 e^180 f (m/k) b log b, oddClassBound <= x^2000, twistError <= x^999 (upgrading to <= x_1 for HasSmallRatios), denominatorError <= x^4000, and |StdClasses_{U(1)}| <= x^30, summing over any finite prime set T to sum_{ell in T} (clearingBound D ell + v_ell(|StdClasses|)) log ell <= D.denominatorBudget = f a log^3 b / (m k). Band 4 (Cobalt and Rust finale) presents New.exists_isRegularFamily (exists theta : PrimePadicIso -> D.MFoldTwist, D.IsRegularFamily theta, chosen independently per iota : PrimePadicIso) plugging directly into Stage 05 LongForms.lean (Theorem C), then Stage 01 star_inequality, and finally Stage 00 GRH and RH with all 8 pillars sealed.
